claims.text: Prevent congenital rubella: unvaccinated pts who could become preg get one dose of MMR, then wait 4 wks b4 trying to conceive
claims.quote: To prevent congenital rubella, unvaccinated patients who could become pregnant should receive one dose of the MMR vaccine and then wait 4 weeks before trying to conceive.

claims.text: MMR = live vax; contraindicated in preg
claims.quote: MMR is a live vaccine and is contraindicated during pregnancy.

claims.text: Postpartum MMR for women w/o evidence of rubella immunity should ⍉be delayed
claims.quote: However, postpartum administration of MMR vaccine to women who lack presumptive evidence of immunity to rubella should not be delayed
claims.locator: Prevention of Measles, Rubella, Congenital Rubella Syndrome, and Mumps, 2013 (MMWR Recomm Rep 2013;62(RR-4))
